name: Sanguine Mend consumes the Saturating Sutures cost reduction (#11227)
contract: Saturating Sutures 504137 is a native aura 108 SPELLMOD_COST modifier with BasePoints -101 over the nine Sanguine Mend ranks and reads 'Reduces the cost of your next Sanguine Mend by 100%'. Nothing spent it, so every mend in its 8 s window stayed free and the proc kept renewing it (#11227). The buff is fixtured with set_aura, the acquisition path is covered by bloodmage-saturating-sutures-cost. With the buff the resource cost of 504086 must be 0; the successful mend must remove 504137 and restore the full cost.

steps.label: Injured fixture so the mend has something to heal
SETUP: Sanguine Mend has a resource cost without the buff
SETUP: the buff makes Sanguine Mend free
DISCRIMINATING: the mend consumes the buff
The next mend costs its full price again
